title: Golden Retriever
content: Golden Retrievers are friendly, energetic dogs prone to hip dysplasia and certain cancers in later life. Regular exercise and periodic joint check-ups during Medical Consultations are recommended.

title: British Shorthair
content: British Shorthair cats are calm and sturdy, but prone to obesity and heart conditions (HCM). Weight monitoring and regular check-ups are recommended.

title: German Shepherd
content: German Shepherds are intelligent working dogs prone to hip and elbow dysplasia and digestive sensitivities. Joint supplements and regular vet visits help manage long-term health.

title: Persian Cat
content: Persian cats have long coats requiring frequent Grooming Sessions to prevent matting, and flat faces that can cause breathing and eye issues requiring monitoring.
